import.description: Add or update many items at once. Rows are matched by SKU: existing items are updated, new ones are created.

import.tooBig: This file is too large (over 2 million characters). Split it into smaller files.

import.noErrors: No problems found. You can import now.

availability.title: Out of stock
availability.description: Mark dishes as out of stock (86) when the kitchen runs out. Captains and the QR menu stop offering them at once.

floor.title: Floor plan
floor.description: Areas and tables as they stand in the restaurant, and the QR codes on each table.
floor.noAreas: No areas yet. Add one, e.g. Ground floor or Rooftop.

areas.label: Floor areas

tables.label: Table name
tables.labelHint: Up to 12 characters, e.g. T1 or R2.
tables.retireHint: A table with a running order can’t be retired until its bill is settled.

layout.help: Drag a table to move it. Or select a table and use the arrow keys (Shift moves 4 cells). Press Enter to edit it.
layout.tileLabel: Table {label}, {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}, column {column, number}, row {row, number}

layout.overlap: Some tables overlap (dashed red outline). Move them apart before saving.
layout.conflictTitle: Someone else changed the floor plan
layout.conflictBody: Nothing was saved. Load the latest plan: your moves are kept on top of it, and you can save again.

qr.title: QR code for {label}
qr.description: Guests scan it to see the menu for this table.
qr.none: This table has no QR code yet.

captain.tileOrderLabel: Table {label}, {status}, open {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, {amount}{ready, plural, =0 {} one {, # dish ready} other {, # dishes ready}}

transfer.moveHint: The order moves to a free table. {label} becomes free.
transfer.mergeHint: This order’s items join the order on the table you pick.
transfer.noOpen: No other table has a running order.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.description: Tables booked ahead. A booked table shows its time on the floor.

reservations.phoneHint: Optional. Adds the guest to Customers.
reservations.tableHint: A table is held for 2 hours either side of the time.
reservations.whenError: Pick a date and a time.
reservations.noFreeTable: No table is free right now. Mark them seated, and open their table when one frees up.
reservations.countToday: {count, plural, =0 {no bookings left today} one {# booking left today} other {# bookings left today}}

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Tablets, KDS screens and tills paired with this Hub. Unpairing a device signs it out at once.
devices.name: Device name
devices.nameHint: Where it is used, e.g. Captain tab 2 or Tandoor screen.
devices.kindChangeHint: The device switches the next time it starts or reloads.

kindHints.CAPTAIN: Floor view and order pad for waiters.
kindHints.KDS: Opens the kitchen display full screen.
kindHints.TOKEN_DISPLAY: Opens the ready-token screen full screen.

devices.unpairBody: The device is signed out at once and PIN sign-in stops working on it. To use it again, pair it with a new code.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.description: Name the device and choose what it is used for. You’ll get a code and a QR to open on it.
pair.step1: On the new device, connect to the restaurant Wi-Fi.
pair.step2: Scan the QR code with its camera, or open {url} in Chrome.
pair.step3: Enter the code if it is not filled in, and tap Pair.
pair.fingerprint: Hub certificate fingerprint (compare it on the device)
pair.doneBody: It is set up as {kind}. Staff can now sign in on it with their PIN.

peripherals.description: Barcode scanners, scales, cash drawers and other devices connected to the Hub or to a paired device.
peripherals.name: Name
peripherals.nameHint: Where it is, e.g. Counter scanner.
peripherals.addressHint: Port, IP address or Bluetooth name, if it has one.

pairing.title: Pair this device
pairing.step1: An admin opens Admin → Devices → Pair a device on another screen and gets a code.
pairing.step2: Install the Hub’s certificate on this device (below), so it can use the secure connection.
pairing.step3: Enter the code here (scanning the admin’s QR fills it in) and tap Pair.
pairing.certWhy: This page is open over plain HTTP. Installing the Hub’s certificate lets this device use the secure address, which Bluetooth and the camera need.
pairing.android2: Open Settings → Security & privacy → More security settings → Encryption & credentials.
pairing.android3: Tap Install a certificate → CA certificate → Install anyway, and choose the downloaded file.
pairing.android4: Check that the fingerprint below matches the one on the admin’s screen.
pairing.codeHint: 8 letters and digits, from the admin’s screen.
pairing.codeError: Enter the code shown on the admin’s screen.
pairing.successBody: This device is now {name}, used as {kind}.
pairing.nextSignIn: Next, staff sign in with their PIN.
pairing.nextFullScreen: It will now open as {kind}, full screen.
pairing.alreadyBody: This device is paired as {name} ({kind}). Pair it again only if the admin asked you to.

closed.PENDING_APPROVAL: This QR order waits for a captain to confirm it.
closed.BILLED: This order is billed. Ask the cashier to make changes.
closed.PAID: This order is paid and closed.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Encrypted copies of everything on the Hub. One is taken automatically every day.

import.description: A .rbak file from a USB drive or another PC.
import.passphraseHint: The passphrase of the Hub that made this backup.

restore.warning: All orders, bills, menu and staff changes made after this backup are replaced by the backup’s data.
restore.safety: A safety backup of today’s data is taken first, so you can go back to it.
restore.restart: The Hub restarts: every till, tablet and kitchen screen disconnects for a few seconds.
restore.signIn: You may have to sign in again afterwards.
restore.passphraseHint: Only for a backup made on another PC or with another passphrase.

restore.waitBodyPlain: The Hub is restarting. This screen reconnects by itself.

restore.slowBody: Check that the Hub PC is on, then reload this page.
restore.done: Backup restored. Every screen has been reloaded.

channels.title: Sales channels
channels.description: Swiggy, Zomato and your own online orders, with their commission and price markup.

items.title: Stock items
items.description: Raw material in the store room: what is on hand, what it cost and when to reorder.
items.empty: No stock items yet. Add the raw material you buy, such as rice, oil or chicken.

item.skuHint: Your code for it, e.g. RICE-BAS: letters, digits, - and _.
item.categoryHint: Groups the list, e.g. Grains, Meat, Dairy.
item.baseHint: Stock, recipes and counts use this unit. It can’t change once stock has moved.
item.baseLocked: Stock has moved, so the unit is fixed.
item.purchaseHint: Receipts and counts start in this unit, e.g. kg or dozen.
item.perishableHint: Receipts get an expiry date and the earliest expiry is used first.
item.shelfLifeHint: Receipts without an expiry date expire this many days after they arrive.
item.reorderHint: At or below this, the item shows as Low.
item.maxHint: Above this, it shows as Over max. Leave it empty for no limit.
item.unitsUnavailable: The list of units could not be loaded: enter quantities in g, ml or pc for now.
item.shelfLifeBadge: Perishable · {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

entry.title: Stock in and out
entry.description: Goods bought without a purchase order, opening stock, wastage and corrections.

hints.receive: Goods bought directly, from the market or a local shop. Enter what each line cost in all.
hints.opening: What was already on the shelves when you started with RestroOS: each item once, before it is first received. Sales before it are fine.
hints.wastage: Spoiled, spilt or expired. It is taken at average cost, earliest expiry first.
hints.adjust: A correction outside a stock count: more found, or less, than the books say.

entry.switchBody: What you typed here is not saved yet. Switching to {kind} clears it.
entry.expiryDefault: Optional: without one it expires {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after today.
entry.referenceHint: Optional: the seller’s bill number, so the receipt can be traced.
entry.reasonHint: Say what happened, e.g. “Milk went sour”.

saved.receive: {count, plural, one {Stock received for # item.} other {Stock received for # items.}}
saved.opening: {count, plural, one {Opening stock saved for # item.} other {Opening stock saved for # items.}}
saved.wastage: {count, plural, one {Wastage recorded for # item.} other {Wastage recorded for # items.}}
saved.adjust: {count, plural, one {Adjustment saved for # item.} other {Adjustment saved for # items.}}

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.description: Count what is on the shelves; posting a count books every difference as an adjustment.

typeHints.OPENING: At the start of the day, before service.
typeHints.CLOSING: At the end of the day, after service.
typeHints.SPOT: A quick check of a few items, at any time.

counts.draftHint: Enter what you find. Items left empty are not changed.
counts.booksHint: Books when counted is what the books showed when the count was saved (the stock now, for an item not counted yet). Posting books only the difference, so sales made during the count still count.
counts.readOnlyHint: You can see this count; entering quantities needs the count permission.
counts.posted: Count posted: the differences are booked.
counts.postBody: The differences for {counted, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} are booked, {value} in all. Each is counted against the books when it was counted, so sales made since still count. A posted count can’t be changed.
counts.postSaves: Counts not saved yet are saved first.
counts.alreadyPosted: This count has already been posted.
counts.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# quantity can’t be read.} other {# quantities can’t be read.}} Use numbers like 2.5.

alerts.title: Stock alerts
alerts.description: What to reorder, what went negative and what is about to expire.
alerts.badge: {count, plural, one {# needs attention} other {# need attention}}
alerts.allClearBody: Nothing is low, out, negative or about to expire.
alerts.negativeHint: More was sold or used than the books had: a receipt is missing or a recipe is off.
alerts.expiringHint: Lots with stock left that expire within 3 days, or already have.
alerts.noExpiring: Nothing expires in the next 3 days.
alerts.overHint: More on hand than the maximum: money tied up, and perishables at risk.

consumption.title: Consumption
consumption.description: What the recipes say was used, against what the counts found, per item.
consumption.legend: Sold is what the recipes took for the KOTs fired. Variance is how much more was used than that, by count; above {limit}% needs a look.
consumption.empty: No stock items to report on.
consumption.flagged: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} more than {limit}% off the recipes.

recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.description: What the dish takes from stock, so every KOT uses up its ingredients. Costs are at today’s average cost.
recipe.readOnly: What the dish takes from stock. Only store-room staff can change it.
recipe.saveDishFirst: Save the dish first, then add its recipe.
recipe.fallbackHint: A size without its own recipe uses the dish’s.
recipe.noDishRecipe: {size} has no recipe of its own, and the dish has none either: it takes nothing from stock.
recipe.none: No recipe yet: this dish takes nothing from stock.
recipe.yieldHint: The quantities are for this many portions, e.g. a batch of 10 naan.
recipe.trimHint: Trim loss is what goes in cleaning and cutting, on top of the quantity.
recipe.estimateHint: Estimated at today’s average cost; the Hub’s figure follows when you save.
recipe.removeDishBody: The dish will stop taking stock. Sizes with their own recipe keep it.
recipe.removeSizeBody: {size} will use the dish’s recipe again.

addon.title: What {name} takes from stock
addon.description: For one of this add-on on one portion, e.g. extra cheese = 30 g of cheese. Leave it empty if it takes nothing.

errors.quantity: Enter a quantity such as 2.5 (up to three decimals).
errors.duplicate: This item is on another line too: opening stock goes in once per item.
errors.maxAboveReorder: The maximum must be more than the reorder level.
